id: title:andehen:remove the experiment get all alias

review.posthog_relevance: Removes deprecated tool aliases and their registrations from the MCP schema and tool map, potentially breaking compatibility for agents or CLI invoking these aliases, though the replacement implementation is not shown.
review.reason: The chunk removes deprecated aliases and their registrations from the MCP schema and tool map. This could break compatibility if agents or CLI still invoke these aliases, but the replacement implementation is not shown. This is a narrow, localized maintenance change.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the removal of deprecated aliases, but the tier could be higher if the replacement implementation and migration compatibility layer are also shown. The tier could be lower if the removal is not accompanied by a replacement implementation.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the replacement tool, the migration compatibility layer, or tests for the new tool. It only removes the deprecated alias and its documentation. This makes it impossible to assess the broader systemic change or the implementation of the replacement.
